product_overview: Zenrixa is a VR glasses and creative tool storefront where users can create an account, choose a subscription plan, complete a Stripe checkout, and review their purchase history. The public landing page also supports plan selection and quick access to sign up or log in.
core_goals: Create a Zenrixa account with email and password
Log in to an existing account
Select a subscription plan and billing cycle
Complete payment through the in-page Stripe checkout
View purchase history and purchase status on the account page

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Visitors can create a new Zenrixa account using email and password from the standalone signup page or the embedded signup modal.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup.html -> Enter a valid email address -> Enter a password with at least 6 characters -> Submit the signup form -> See account creation success and, if a session is created, continue to account page
Navigate to /signup.html -> Enter an invalid email address or a too-short password -> Submit the signup form -> See an inline validation or signup error message
Navigate to /signup.html -> Choose the Google sign-in option -> Complete the OAuth flow -> Return to the app as a signed-in user

features.name: User Login
features.description: Returning users can sign in with email and password from the standalone login page or the embedded login modal on the landing page.
user_flows: Navigate to /login.html -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See successful sign-in and continue to the landing page or pending checkout
Navigate to /landing.html -> Open the login modal -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See successful sign-in and continue to checkout when a plan was already selected
Navigate to /landing.html -> Open the login modal -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an invalid credentials error message

features.name: Plan Selection
features.description: Visitors can choose a Basic, Standard, or Pro plan with monthly, six-month, or one-time billing from the landing page pricing cards.
user_flows: Navigate to /landing.html -> Review the pricing cards -> Choose a plan and billing cycle -> Continue to checkout with the selected plan details
Navigate to /landing.html -> Log in first -> Choose a plan and billing cycle -> Go directly to checkout with the selected plan details

features.name: Plan Checkout
features.description: Authenticated users can purchase a selected plan using the in-page Stripe card form on the checkout page and then return to their account.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout.html?plan=basic&billing=monthly -> Review the selected plan details -> Enter cardholder name -> Select country or region -> Enter card details in the payment form -> Submit payment -> See success and continue to account page

Navigate to /checkout.html?plan=standard&billing=six -> Review the selected plan details -> Enter cardholder name -> Select country or region -> Enter card details in the payment form -> Submit payment -> See purchase completion and updated account access
Navigate to /checkout.html?plan=pro&billing=forever -> Review the selected plan details -> Leave required payment details incomplete -> Submit payment -> See a payment validation error message

features.name: Purchase History
features.description: Signed-in users can view their purchase history, including plan name, date, amount, currency, and status, on the account page and within the checkout page.
user_flows: Navigate to /account.html -> View the purchase history list -> See each purchase with plan name, date, amount, currency, and status
Navigate to /account.html -> View the purchase history section -> See an empty state when no purchases exist
Navigate to /checkout.html?plan=basic&billing=monthly -> View the purchase history section -> Review existing purchases without leaving the checkout page

tech_stack: Stripe (Elements in-page card form, PaymentIntents, Subscriptions)

routes.description: Landing page with pricing cards, embedded signup/login modals, and checkout modal
Standalone signup page (email + password, Google OAuth). Redirects to account.html if already logged in
In-page Stripe card checkout for VR glasses plans; reads plan and billing query params; shows purchase history
Account page showing the user's purchase history; updates purchase status if session_id is present
Provider/admin dashboard with purchases table and stats
POST signup via Supabase, logs auth event
POST login via Supabase, logs auth event
GET access/refresh token from the server session

features.name: User Signup (email + password)
features.description: Create a new Zenrixa account with email and password. If a session is returned the user is redirected to account.html, otherwise an email confirmation message is shown.
user_interactions: Enter an email address in the Email field
Enter a password (min 6 characters) in the Password field
Click the Sign up button
See success or error message; redirected to account.html when a session exists
Optionally click Continue with Google to sign up via OAuth

features.name: User Login
features.description: Log in with email and password. Redirects to checkout if a plan is pending, otherwise back to the landing page.
user_interactions: Open the login modal from the header
Enter email and password
Click the Log in button
See error message on invalid credentials
Continue to checkout.html if a pending plan was saved in localStorage

features.name: Plan Checkout (Stripe card)
features.description: Select a plan on the landing page (Basic/Standard/Pro, monthly/six-month/forever billing), then pay with an in-page Stripe card form on checkout.html. Requires an authenticated user.
user_interactions: Navigate to checkout.html with plan and billing query params
Enter cardholder name and select country
Enter card details into the Stripe card element
Click the Pay button
On success, redirected to account.html
View purchase history in the checkout page

features.name: Purchase History
features.description: Display a user's purchased plans with status on account.html and checkout.html.
user_interactions: View list of purchases showing plan name, date, amount, and status
See empty state when no purchases exist

features.name: Google OAuth Signup/Login
features.description: Sign up or log in using Google OAuth via Supabase.
user_interactions: Click Continue with Google button
Complete OAuth flow

known_limitations.issue: Checkout relies on Supabase Edge Functions (create-payment-intent / create-subscription) being deployed and Stripe test keys being valid; the in-page card flow may not complete if those functions are not deployed.
known_limitations.impact: Payment on checkout.html may fail or show an error if edge functions are missing or Stripe keys are invalid

known_limitations.issue: Signup success depends on email confirmation; if Supabase confirmations are enabled the user is not redirected to account.html and must click the confirmation link first.
known_limitations.impact: Test signup may end with a confirmation message instead of immediate redirect

known_limitations.issue: Purchase status only becomes active via the Stripe webhook or account.html?s session_id param; payments made through the in-page form may remain pending until the webhook fires.
known_limitations.impact: New purchases may show pending status
